what: Hovering a big banner strip (like Get tickets) expands the panel that was clipped 9% inside to full size (clip inset 9% → 0), the background scales .81 → 1, and a second-color panel grows from 0 to cover it. The text is pushed 80% up, the logo rises into its place, and the arrow line is drawn. Six hidden pieces (letter-shaped photos) scattered around gather, each from its own position and tilt, staggered .04s apart (the first three already underway), wobbling with elastic.out(1, .7) over .8s. On release they all scatter at once with the same curve

options.inset: Amount the panel is clipped inward at rest (%), default 9
options.ease: Expand and gather curve, default elastic.out(1, 0.7)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel to be clipped. If absent, the element clips itself (surrounding pieces get clipped too, as in the original)
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Second color panel that grows from 0 to cover (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=note]: Text that pushes up and out (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Drawn arrow svg — first path inside is the line, second is the head (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Gathering pieces — resting spot is data-from="x: -50; y: -50; r: -16; s: .8"(x·y are % of own size, r deg, s scale)
options.round: Cut-out panel corner radius (px) — if given, clips with inset(… round n px), none by default (the original keeps the panel rounded and only clips)
options.first: Time the first piece departs (seconds), default -.1 — if earlier than 0, it appears on the first frame already advanced by that amount (original <-=0.3, first three pieces start ahead)

use: Text

from.where: home.js Te() .js-cv-banner-link — Ticket band at the bottom of every page (blue panel inset 9% → red, six letter-shaped photos d·o·k·o·m·i)

note: The original pulls the first piece .3s ahead of the arrow head (-.1s) and inserts it before timeline 0, so the first three pieces appear already in progress from the first frame (first default). Touch devices are not hooked, as in the original
